title: P146-M 'smuggled' cigarettes, equipment seized at Zambales pier

blocks.text: IBA, Zambales — More than P146 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and abandoned equipment were seized at a pier in Palauig, Zambales, as authorities formed a composite team to investigate the shipment and track down the vessel that unloaded it. Based on reports, examiners from the Bureau of Customs (BOC) began the inventory on Thursday, removing the master cases from the containers for accounting. The initial inventory yielded 1,863 master cases of cigarettes bearing the brand name Modern from four container vans found at BNB Pier in Sitio Luan in Barangay Lipay.
